items.title: Omarion Hampton: Leading rusher as Chargers remain winless
items.text:
Hampton rushed 13 times for 60 yards and wasn't targeted in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.

items.title: Tank Dell: First touchdown 2024
items.text:
Dell turned a team-high nine targets into four catches for 105 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 44-22 road victory against the Chargers

items.title: Kayshon Boutte: Strikes for two TDs in Week 9
items.text:
Boutte erupted for four catches (on five targets) for 125 yards and two touchdowns during Sunday's 44-22 road win against the Chargers.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Matches Washington with six carries
items.text:
Jeanty rushed six times for 25 yards while catching five of seven targets for minus-5 yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Picked off three times in Week 9 loss
items.text:
Cousins completed 22 of 32 passes for 216 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed twice for no gain and scored a rushing touchdown.
